Elsewhere in the corpus the closure test is written as accepted AND recorded: core-gate-harness-specifications.v4 names its field leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded. decision.scopeOfAccept: ACCEPT of component-manifest-leftover-join.v3 as a DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE at 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no express reservation. The artifact remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and carries DO-NOT-SEAL on its own terms. DR-103 is not SATISFIED, five leftover-design obligations remain, D-056 Class A is not opened, and no D-167 recording is made.
decision.summaryForCoordinator: The whole substantive change is one obligation moving, so I diffed before reading v3's account of itself. Exactly one leaf was removed and the change is surgical: OBL-G15-HARNESS-SPEC goes from leftoverDesign true to false and out of the six-member leftover list, and the other five obligations are byte-identical to v2 and still not-capable-of-riding. That flip rests entirely on the claim that the G15 specification now exists and is independently reviewed, and since I wrote the verdict it leans on I measured every predicate rather than recalling any: the spec exists at the cited digest, its verdict exists at the cited digest with ACCEPT 0/0, no Codex verdict exists, its status is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, its own bytes use QUALIFIED only in negations, and the token D-167 does not appear in it at all. The subject's role annotation is exact on every clause, and it preserves the execution remainder rather than absorbing it — rideStanding becomes qualification-at-named-gate and the reason says G15 execution remains qualification. I also re-ran the artifact's own fixture audit instead of accepting it. Live v6 carries authoredCount 51 and an authored array of length 51, so the count is exact; walking every path-plus-digest object in v6 found 90 entries, and all 90 resolve on disk and reproduce their pinned digest with zero missing and zero mismatches. The audit is true and conservatively stated, and its note correctly avoids implying that D-013's SATISFIED-refusal has been overtaken. The two invention prohibitions hold at source: ENVELOPE_MISMATCH occurs exactly once in live v6, inside notAuthored, and all four uses in the subject are naming or negation with nothing defining it; and every one of the four 'schema successor' mentions is a negation or a forward reference, which is why OBL-UNICODE-NORM stays leftover. Eight of eight cited digests match live, v2 is unmoved at 068a313d, the only DR-G token in the file is the already-named DR-G15, required-now is 26 across thirty gate rows, and git reports zero modified tracked files. Seventeen attacks run, seventeen refuted, zero findings. One thing is yours to decide rather than mine, and I want it in front of you rather than buried. The flip retires an authoring obligation on the strength of a single-reviewer ACCEPT of a candidate that is not yet recorded. Everything a coordinator needs to judge that is stated openly in the artifact — Codex not reviewed, CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, not QUALIFIED, no D-167 — and the lands entry is worded 'authoring-measured' rather than 'closed', with the later recording named in proposedLaterWork. But note the corpus is not uniform on the test: core-gate-harness-specifications.v4 names its field leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded, implying recording is required, while distribution-core-leftover-join.v3 sets the trigger at specifications that exist and are independently reviewed, which this satisfies. Worth noting too that v1 and v2 of this join each carry a Codex verdict and v3 is the first reviewed by one reviewer only. Two smaller notes: the generic doesNot line 'Does not close leftover-design' now sits in slight tension with 'OBL-G15-HARNESS-SPEC authoring is measured closed', resolved correctly by the more specific authorityClaim which enumerates the five that remain, and worth tightening in any later revision; and the windows-path role's 'Awaiting independent review' went stale about a minute after authoring, which is chronology rather than error and does not touch its operative clause that OBL-WINDOWS-PATH is not closed.
